newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Poll sees mixed key Danish firm profits.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Poll sees mixed key Danish firm profits.

text.p: A panel of Danish share analysts polled by Reuters on Tuesday presented rather mixed profit estimates for selected major Danish companies for the period 1995-98 since the last poll in July.

The panel of bank and brokerage firm analysts downwardly adjusted their average 1996 expectations for three of the 10 firms in the survey, cleaning group International Service System A/S (ISS), holding company Sophus Berendsen and shipping and wholesale group East Asiatic Co.
The panel upped estimates only for Denmark's second biggest bank Unidanmark, leaving expectations for the other six companies more or less unchanged.
Following are forecasts for the 1996 and 1997 profit before tax and extraordinary items of 10 Danish blue-chip companies.
The estimates were made by seven banks and brokerage firms polled by Reuters (millions of crowns).
NOTE-*) Danisco accounting year runs from May 1-April 30.
**) FLS Industries' ordinary pre-tax result excludes
losses and gains from the sale of subsidiaries and property.
***) Carlsberg's accounting year runs from Oct 1-Sept 30.

The forecasts were made by Den Danske Bank, Unibank, BG Bank, Jyske Bank, Bjoernskov & Co, Svenska Handelsbanken and Den Koebenhavnske Boers. The four banks first mentioned made no forecasts for Den Danske Bank and Unibank.
